```{r}
# Get list of glycosylation-related genes from 5 GO glyco gene sets
mouse_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus")
msigdbr_collections()
mouse_GO = mouse_gene_sets %>% dplyr::filter(gs_cat == "C5")
go_glycosylation_terms <- c("GOBP_GLYCOSYLATION", "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_PROTEIN_GLYCOSYLATION", "GOBP_PROTEIN_N_LINKED_GLYCOSYLATION","GOMF_GLYCOSYLTRANSFERASE_ACTIVITY",
                            "GOMF_SIALYLTRANSFERASE_ACTIVITY")
glycosylation_table = mouse_GO %>% dplyr::filter(gs_name %in% go_glycosylation_terms)
glycosylation_genes = as.vector(unique(glycosylation_table$human_gene_symbol))
```

Differentially expressed glycosylation genes
```{r}
de_genes <- function(data, genes){
  res <- data[rownames(data) %in% genes,]
  res <- res[(!is.na(res$padj)) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2,]
  res <- res[order(res$log2FoldChange,decreasing=T),]
  return(res)
}
ctrl_glyco <- de_genes(ctrl_res, glycosylation_genes)
# Make an excel sheet with these genes pb3_vs_pb2
genesets <- list("ctrlpb3_vs_ctrlpb2_glyco"=ctrl_glyco)
write.xlsx(genesets,file.path("./Data/Pb3_Pb2_Bulk_glycosylation_genes.xlsx"),rowNames=T)
```

```{r}
mode(tpm) <- "numeric"
tpm_log <- log2(tpm + 1)
```
```{r}
# Add Epi and Mes scores to CCLE data 
# Take top 25% and bottom 25% cell lines --> compare expression of TMEME165, 
# Split breast cancer cell lines and do the same (maybe top and bottom 1/3)
# Match gene names to ENSEMBL IDs
rownames(tpm_log) <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(tpm_log))
genenames <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
resp_table <- merge(tpm_log, genenames, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
resp_table <- resp_table[!duplicated(resp_table$SYMBOL),]
resp_table <- resp_table %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
resp_table <- resp_table[,2:dim(resp_table)[2]]
resp_table <- as.matrix(resp_table)
```

```{r}
# Make metadata with EMT scores 
epi.markers <- c("EPCAM","CDH1","KRT8","KRT18","KRT19","CLDN1","CLDN3","CLDN4","OCLN","DSP","TJP1")
mes.markers <- c("CDH2","VIM","FN1","SNAI1","SNAI2","ZEB1","ZEB2","TWIST1","ITGA5","ITGB1","COL1A1")
meta <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 0, nrow = dim(resp_table)[2]))
rownames(meta) <- colnames(resp_table)
meta$Epi.Score <- colMeans(resp_table[intersect(epi.markers,rownames(resp_table)),])
meta$Mes.Score <- colMeans(resp_table[intersect(mes.markers,rownames(resp_table)),])
meta$EMT.Score <- (meta$Mes.Score - meta$Epi.Score)/(meta$Mes.Score + meta$Epi.Score)
#meta$EMT.Score2 <- meta$Mes.Score - meta$Epi.Score
```

```{r}

meta$SLC35A2 <- resp_table["SLC35A2",]
meta$CEBPB <- resp_table["CEBPB",]
# Pb3 vs. Pb2 glycosylation genes

meta$BT549_glyco <- colMeans(resp_table[intersect(bt549_glycan$x,rownames(resp_table)),]) # 24 BT549 TGFb-induced glycosylation-related genes

meta$human_glyco = colMeans(resp_table[intersect(human_glyco_genes, rownames(resp_table)),])
```

```{r}
meta.breast <- meta[grepl("BREAST", rownames(meta)),]
```

```{r}
# Classify as Epi or Mes
classify <- function(meta){
  q1 <- quantile(meta$EMT.Score, 0.5)
  q3 <- quantile(meta$EMT.Score, 0.5)
  state <- rep("Intermediate", length(meta$EMT.Score))
  state[meta$EMT.Score < q1] <- "Epi"
  state[meta$EMT.Score >= q3] <- "Mes"
  plot(density(meta$EMT.Score))
  abline(v=c(q1,q3))
  return(state)
}
meta.breast$state <- classify(meta.breast)
```

```{r}
ggplot(meta.breast, aes(x = state, y = SLC35A2)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(state)), width=0.3,size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(state)), width = 0.8, alpha = 0)+
  stat_compare_means(method="t.test",label="p.format",hide.ns = T,comparisons = list(c(1,2)))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=13),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5,size=13),
```

3B. Comparison between Metastasis and primary tumors 
```{r}
# Get Raw counts
# Do DEseq between metastasis and primary tumors
# Get significantly DE gene list
# Examine EMT profile, glycosylaiton related genes...
counts <- read.table(file.path(dir2,"Question 3B Metastasis/GSE209998_AUR_129_raw_counts.txt"),header=T,sep="\t")
series_matrix <- read.table(file.path(dir2, "Question 3B Metastasis/GSE209998_series_matrix.txt"),header=T,skip=88,sep="\t",nrows=44)
counts <- counts[!duplicated(counts$X),]
counts <- counts %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var="X")
```
```{r}
series_matrix <- series_matrix[,2:length(series_matrix)]
meta <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 0, nrow = length(counts)))
rownames(meta) <- colnames(counts)
meta$site <- sub("^disease: ", "",series_matrix[9,])
meta$site <- sub(" .*", "", meta$site)
meta$sampleID <- sub("^", "",series_matrix[22,])
meta$patientID <- substr(meta$sampleID, 5, 8)
```
```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(limma)

dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)   # TMM normalization

group <- factor(meta$site) # Primary, Metastasis, or Normal
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

v <- voom(dge, design)
fit <- lmFit(v, design)
contr <- makeContrasts(
  Met_vs_Primary = Metastatic - Primary,
  Primary_vs_Normal = Primary - Normal,
  Met_vs_Normal = Metastatic - Normal,
  levels = design
)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contr))

res.met_primary <- topTable(fit2,coef="Met_vs_Primary", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
# Save Res file and glycosylation file
res.signf <- res.met_primary[(abs(res.met_primary$logFC) > 0.5 & res.met_primary$adj.P.Val <0.05), ]
res.signf <- res.signf[order(res.signf$logFC,decreasing = T),]
res.signf.glyco <- res.signf[rownames(res.signf) %in% glycosylation_genes, ]
res.glyco.up <- rownames(res.signf.glyco[res.signf.glyco$logFC>0,])
write.table(res.signf.glyco,file.path(dir2,"Question 3B Metastasis/Met_vs_Primary_glycogenes.txt"),sep="\t",row.names = T)
```
```{r}
plot_volcano <- function(table, glist,title){
  # Add lab for IFNa, IFNg, and MHC genes
  resp_table <- table %>% mutate(label = ifelse(rownames(table) %in% glist, rownames(table),NA))
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    rownames(resp_table) %in% glist, 'red',
        'lightgrey')
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'lightgrey'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'red'] <- 'Glycosylation-related Genes'
  EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=resp_table$label, x="logFC", y="adj.P.Val",pCutoff=0.05, title= title,xlim=c(-4,4),ylim=c(0,18),colCustom = keyvals,pointSize = 1, FCcutoff=0.25, drawConnectors = TRUE,labSize=4,max.overlaps = 30)
}
plot_volcano(res.signf, rownames(res.signf.glyco),"Metastasis vs. Primary Breast Cancer")
```

```{r}
UQN <- read.table(file.path(dir2,"Question 3B Metastasis/GSE209998_AUR_129_UQN.txt"),header=T,sep="\t")
UQN <- UQN[!duplicated(UQN$X),]
UQN <- UQN %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var="X")
expr <- log2(UQN + 1)
```
```{r}
epi.markers <- c("EPCAM","CDH1","KRT8","KRT18","KRT19","CLDN1","CLDN3","CLDN4","OCLN","DSP","TJP1")
mes.markers <- c("CDH2","VIM","FN1","SNAI1","SNAI2","ZEB1","ZEB2","TWIST1","ITGA5","ITGB1","COL1A1")
# Calculate z-scores 

epi_use <- intersect(epi.markers, rownames(expr))
mes_use <- intersect(mes.markers, rownames(expr))

meta$Epi_score <- colMeans(expr[epi_use, , drop = FALSE])
meta$Mes_score <- colMeans(expr[mes_use, , drop = FALSE])

meta$EMT_score <- (meta$Mes_score - meta$Epi_score)/(meta$Mes_score + meta$Epi_score)
```
```{r}
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
meta$TMEM165 <- expr["TMEM165",]
meta$SLC35A2 <- expr["SLC35A2",]
# Pb3 vs. Pb2 glycosylation genes
pb3_glyco = read.xlsx(file.path(dir2, "Question 1/Pb3_Pb2_Bulk_glycosylation_genes.xlsx"),sheet="ctrlpb3_vs_ctrlpb2_glyco",rowNames = T)
pb3_glyco_genes = pb3_glyco[pb3_glyco$log2FoldChange>0,]$Human_symbol
meta$pb3_glyco = colMeans(expr[intersect(pb3_glyco_genes,rownames(expr)),])
# Calculate glycosylation signatures
bt549_glycan = read.csv("~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/Re_ Survival Plots/BT549_sig_up_Glycan_genes.tsv",sep="\t")
meta$BT549_glyco <- colMeans(expr[intersect(bt549_glycan$x,rownames(expr)),]) # 24 BT549 TGFb-induced glycosylation-related genes
# 98 glycosylation genes upregulated in human breast Mes vs. Epi
human_breast_glyco <- read.table(file.path(dir2, "Question 1/Xu_Human_NMF_Harmony_Mes_Epi_Glycosylation_Genes.txt"),sep="\t",header=T)
human_glyco_genes <- rownames(human_breast_glyco[human_breast_glyco$avg_log2FC > 0.5 & human_breast_glyco$p_val_adj<0.05,])
meta$human_glyco = colMeans(expr[intersect(human_glyco_genes, rownames(expr)),])

meta$site <- factor(meta$site, levels=c("Normal","Primary","Metastatic"))
ggplot(meta, aes(x = site, y = human_glyco)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(site)), width=0.3,size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(site)), width = 0.8, alpha = 0)+
  stat_compare_means(method="t.test",label="p.format",hide.ns = T,comparisons = list(c(1,2),c(1,3),c(2,3)))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=13),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5,size=13),
        legend.position="none",axis.title.x = element_blank())
```

4. Plot human and mouse glycosylation gene heatmaps 
```{r}
dir2 <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/computational analysis"
pb3_glyco = read.xlsx(file.path(dir2, "Question 1/Pb3_Pb2_Bulk_glycosylation_genes.xlsx"),sheet="ctrlpb3_vs_ctrlpb2_glyco",rowNames = T)
human_breast_glyco <- read.table(file.path(dir2, "Question 1/Xu_Human_NMF_Harmony_Mes_Epi_Glycosylation_Genes.txt"),sep="\t",header=T,row.names = 1)
pb3_labels <- c("Mgat3","Mgat4b","St8sia2","St8sia1","St8sia4","St3gal1","St3gal4","Xylt1","Gxylt2","Csgalnact1","B3galt4","B4galt6","B4galt5","B3galt1","Galnt3")
pb3_indices <- which(rownames(pb3_glyco) %in% pb3_labels)
  
human_labels <- c("MGAT3","ST8SIA1","ST3GAL6","ST3GAL2","GXYLT2","XYLT1","A4GALT","B4GALT4","B4GALT6","GALNT16","GALNT6","GALNT5","GALNT7")
human_indices <- which(rownames(human_breast_glyco) %in% human_labels)

Heatmap(as.matrix(pb3_glyco[c("log2FoldChange")]), 
        show_row_names = FALSE, # Hide default dense row labels
        right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
          link = anno_mark(at = pb3_indices, labels = rownames(pb3_glyco)[pb3_indices])
        ))
Heatmap(as.matrix(human_breast_glyco[c("avg_log2FC")]),
        show_row_names = F,
        right_annotation = rowAnnotation(link=anno_mark(at=human_indices,labels = rownames(human_breast_glyco)[human_indices])))
```
